biography.value:
Vaelzhar, the Unremembered

Species: Rauwend Nullwyrm
Abyssal Origin: Layer 45 of Azzagrat — Rauwend
Palanthas Anchor: the Great Library and the city's accumulated memory.

Rauwend is the gray, windswept face of Azzagrat where sound, sensation, direction, and recollection are subdued. Vaelzhar is a colossal draconic planar nail binding that law to the Abyssal twin of Palanthas. Its presence makes records fade, streets become difficult to remember, and witnesses forget the sequence of events they just survived.
biography.public: A colossal demonic dragon whose presence consumes sound, certainty, and memory.

source.license: Private campaign material. Not for distribution.

description.value: The wyrm makes three [[/item Rend]] attacks. It can replace one attack with [[/item Memory Shear]].
[[/attack extended]]. Hit: [[/damage 3d10 + @abilities.str.mod type=slashing average=true]] plus [[/damage 2d10 type=psychic average=true]] damage.

Wisdom Saving Throw: [[/save wis 25 format=long]], each creature in a 120-foot Cone. Failure: [[/damage 18d10 type=psychic average=true]] damage; until the end of its next turn the creature's Speed is halved, it cannot take Reactions, and it has Disadvantage on attack rolls. Success: Half damage only.

One creature the wyrm can see within 120 feet makes a [[/save wis 24 format=long]]. Failure: [[/damage 6d10 type=psychic average=true]] damage; until the end of its next turn it cannot take Reactions and cannot gain Advantage from another creature's actions or features. Success: Half damage only.
The wyrm teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see that is in Dim Light, Darkness, fog, or other visual obscuration. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.

Trigger: A creature the wyrm can see hits it with an attack. The attacker makes a [[/save wis 24 format=long]]. On a failure, the creature cannot target the wyrm with another attack until the beginning of its next turn. The triggering attack still deals damage.

The wyrm can move through the spaces of Huge or smaller creatures; those spaces are difficult terrain. The first time on a turn it enters another creature's space, that creature must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take [[/damage 4d10 type=bludgeoning average=true]] damage, be pushed to the nearest unoccupied space, and have the Prone condition. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.
The wyrm has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

While within Abyssal Palanthas, the wyrm is considered to be inside its lair. Its death permanently damages the planar correspondence between its native layer of Azzagrat and the mortal city of Palanthas. Vaelzhar anchors Rauwend to the Great Library and to Palanthas' memory of itself.
Vaelzhar does not require air, food, drink, or sleep. In areas of supernatural silence, fog, or memory distortion, it has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

A hostile creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the wyrm must make a [[/save wis 24 format=long]]. On a failure, until the beginning of its next turn it cannot take Reactions and has Disadvantage on ability checks and Constitution saving throws made to maintain Concentration. After succeeding, it is immune to this aura until the beginning of its next turn.
If the wyrm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. In its lair it has 5 uses; outside its lair reduce the maximum to 4.

Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the wyrm can expend a use to take one of the following actions. It regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

Tail Rend. The wyrm makes one Rend attack.

Gray Wing. The wyrm flies up to half its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks; creatures within 15 feet of its starting space may be knocked Prone.

Unremembered Moment. One creature within 120 feet risks temporarily losing its reactions and its ability to benefit from Help.
[[/attack extended]]. Hit: [[/damage 3d10 + @abilities.str.mod type=slashing average=true]] plus [[/damage 2d10 type=psychic average=true]] damage. This Legendary Action costs 1 use.

The wyrm flies up to half its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature within 15 feet of where the wyrm begins this movement makes a [[/save dex 25 format=long]] or gains the Prone condition.

One creature the wyrm can see within 120 feet makes a [[/save wis 24 format=long]]. On a failure, it cannot take Reactions and other creatures cannot use the Help action on it until the end of its next turn.

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the wyrm can use one lair action; it cannot use the same lair action two rounds in a row unless the GM chooses otherwise for a mythic scene.

The Drowned Bell. Choose a point within 120 feet. Sound disappears within a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered there. The area is under supernatural silence until initiative count 20 of the next round.

The Street That Wasn't There. Up to three creatures the wyrm can see make a [[/save cha 24 format=long]]. On a failure, a creature is teleported up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space chosen by the wyrm.

Vipers of Zrintor. Serpentine branches erupt in a 20-foot-radius area. Creatures there make a [[/save dex 24 format=long]]. On a failure, a creature takes [[/damage 4d10 type=piercing average=true]] damage and gains the Restrained condition. A Restrained creature can use an action to make a DC 24 Strength (Athletics) check, ending the condition on a success.
